notes.name: presenting_complaint_hpi
notes.text: A male aged 64 years admitted to hospital with an arteriosclerotic cerebral infarction.

notes.name: progress_notes
notes.text: He was transferred to rehabilitation two months later where he developed hypostatic pneumonia.

notes.name: cause_of_death_information
notes.text: In ICU sputum cultured Klebsiella pneumoniae and the patient died 2 days after admission to the ICU.

notes.name: treatment_medications
notes.text: He was also addicted to alcohol for the past 20 years and on regular medication for Ischaemic heart disease for the last 10 years.
